sentences.en: I applied some suntan block before going to the beach.
sentences.zh: 我去海滩前涂了一些防晒霜。

sentences.en: Don't forget to put on your suntan block when you go outside in summer.
sentences.zh: 夏天出门别忘了涂防晒霜。

sentences.en: She used a high SPF suntan block to protect her skin from the sun's rays.
sentences.zh: 她用了高倍数的防晒霜来保护皮肤不受阳光照射。
